svg.title: Mutation-triggered Report refresh — synchronous, not background
svg.desc: Quick overview · follow 01 → 09 · runs inside the mutation's own request
svg.text: Mutation-triggered Report refresh — synchronous, not background
Quick overview · follow 01 → 09 · runs inside the mutation's own request

g.text: reserve → write → confirm → fenced derived-data sync
Synchronously, awaited before the HTTP response
The whole mutation answers 500 — see the note
No — nothing is queued or backgrounded
After a committed write, synchronizeAfterMutation confirms durable pending work and attempts a fenced
report refresh before the mutation response.
A failed derived-data attempt remains pending for repair-on-read rather than being silently treated as fresh.

svg.text: This flow is shared by Expense, Income, and Budget mutations. It uses the same PendingSync evidence and revision fencing that report reads validate.
